description: ASTRAL score for acute ischemic stroke prognosis. Takes clinical variables (age, admission NIHSS, onset-to-admission time, visual field defect, acute glucose, level of consciousness) as CSV and returns the ASTRAL score and a risk category for unfavorable 90-day functional outcome (mRS>2). Deterministic integer score (Ntaios 2012).
disease: acute ischemic stroke, ischemic stroke, stroke prognosis, functional outcome, mRS
